name: 湖南大学
character: Built against Yuelu Mountain and stretching east to the Xiang River, the campus blends black-and-white Ming-Qing academy courtyards, red-walled green-tiled Republican buildings, and modern halls.

landmarks.name: 岳麓书院
landmarks.quote: 岳麓书院的建筑大部分为明清遗构，以黑白色调为主，为中国现存规模最大的书院建筑群。
landmarks.look: Black-and-white Ming-Qing courtyard complex arranged along a central axis.

landmarks.name: 岳麓山
landmarks.quote: 主校区东濒湘江，西偎岳麓山
landmarks.look: Mountain rising immediately to the west of the campus.

landmarks.name: 大礼堂
landmarks.quote: 代表作品有一院，二院，大礼堂，老图书馆，科技馆等。
landmarks.look: Republican-era auditorium with red walls and green tiles.

landmarks.name: 老图书馆
landmarks.quote: 代表作品有一院，二院，大礼堂，老图书馆，科技馆等。
landmarks.look: Republican-era library building with red walls and green tiles.

landmarks.name: 科学馆
landmarks.quote: 包括老图书馆、科学馆、大礼堂、工程馆、二院（现物理实验楼）
landmarks.look: Republican-era science building with red walls and green tiles.

landmarks.name: 工程馆
landmarks.quote: 包括老图书馆、科学馆、大礼堂、工程馆、二院（现物理实验楼）
landmarks.look: Republican-era engineering hall with red walls and green tiles.

landmarks.name: 二院
landmarks.quote: 包括老图书馆、科学馆、大礼堂、工程馆、二院（现物理实验楼）
landmarks.look: Republican-era academic hall with red walls and green tiles.

landmarks.name: 御书楼
landmarks.quote: 主体建筑如头门、大门、二门、讲堂、御书楼集中于中轴线上
landmarks.look: Traditional Ming-Qing pavilion tower on the central axis of Yuelu Academy.
